# Data Generator

Here we can monitor the rate at which events are being produced in the data generator.

On the left we can see the aggregated rate at which events are produced.
This can be configured with the configured rate, for sufficiently low rates these should be the same (I expect them to diverge at higher rates as the data-generator struggles to keep up).

On the right we can see the breakdown of events produced per event type.
